title: Watch a rocket leave the Space Coast
description: Choose a public launch viewing location, arrive early, and follow the countdown with everyone around you. For a few seconds after liftoff, the rocket climbs almost silently in the distance before the sound reaches you. Kennedy Space Center offers selected viewing opportunities with expert commentary; launch times and access can change, so leave flexibility in your trip.
teaser: Feel the delay between a rocket’s light and sound.
goodToKnow: Launches can move or be cancelled. Plan this as part of a longer Space Coast visit and choose a seated viewing option.
whyItMightDelightYou: The shared wait makes the brief moment of liftoff feel enormous.
